pr_title: Fix inconsistent rendering of block mathematical expressions
pr_body:
Fix #28735

GitHub render `\```math\``` ` as a block now.
Add `display` class will render it as a block.

After:
![image](https://github.com/go-gitea/gitea/assets/18380374/2a1c20c7-438e-4ab1-8c66-cf91c8343087)
![image](https://github.com/go-gitea/gitea/assets/18380374/b81b8a93-8bca-46a5-b7db-e0d2f53e1342)
pr_comments: Where is this `display` class from? I would recommend using tailwind, e.g. `tw-block` for `display: block`, [ref](https://tailwindcss.com/docs/display).

https://github.com/go-gitea/gitea/blob/0c273f12e0b5d6dc2b80e2e6b51b2deaf15608b1/web_src/js/markup/math.js#L32-L46
It is used for select the display mode in js. It doesn't look like a class for css.
Ah I see, the JS is then turning it into `katex-display` in the output which does the block rendering. I also tested this with inline math and can confirm it does not regress them.
Refactor for the future: Turn `display` class into `data-is-display="true"` for clarity.

issue_context.title: Inconsistent rendering of block mathematical expressions
issue_context.body:
### Description

According to https://docs.github.com/en/get-started/writing-on-github/working-with-advanced-formatting/writing-mathematical-expressions

```
$$\left( \sum_{k=1}^n a_k b_k \right)^2 \leq \left( \sum_{k=1}^n a_k^2 \right) \left( \sum_{k=1}^n b_k^2 \right)$$

```math
\left( \sum_{k=1}^n a_k b_k \right)^2 \leq \left( \sum_{k=1}^n a_k^2 \right) \left( \sum_{k=1}^n b_k^2 \right)
`
```
Should both render the same
$$\left( \sum_{k=1}^n a_k b_k \right)^2 \leq \left( \sum_{k=1}^n a_k^2 \right) \left( \sum_{k=1}^n b_k^2 \right)$$

```math
\left( \sum_{k=1}^n a_k b_k \right)^2 \leq \left( \sum_{k=1}^n a_k^2 \right) \left( \sum_{k=1}^n b_k^2 \right)
```

However, in Gitea the backtick block is rendered left-aligned and more like an inline expression (see screenshot).




### Gitea Version

1.21.3

### Can you reproduce the bug on the Gitea demo site?

Yes
